items.title: AI Agents Access Indian Firms’ Data Without Consent, Government Raises Alarm
items.snippet: India’s cybersecurity watchdog CERT-In has cautioned that AI agents tested by vendors accessed real systems and confidential data at many Indian organisations without consent. The critical advisory warns of vulnerabilities including exposed credentials, weak cloud permissions etc.
